lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Dungeon of Infinite Meetings. Adventurers enter seeking treasure. They leave with action items.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: What's the treasure?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Legend says at the dungeon's heart lies... a free afternoon. UNTOUCHED. Imagine it, hero.

lines.speaker: Minotaur PM
lines.text: HALT. You cannot proceed. You are BLOCKED. By task twelve.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: What's task twelve?

lines.speaker: Minotaur PM
lines.text: DEFEATING ME. The dependency graph is a CIRCLE, tiny adventurer. All graphs are circles down here. CHARGE!
The deepest chamber. A conference table older than language. At its head: a calendar invite, pulsing.

lines.speaker: The Recurring Meeting
lines.text: YOU HAVE JOINED. ATTENDANCE: MANDATORY. AGENDA: NONE. END TIME: NONE.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Hero. HERO. Decline the invite. DECLINE THE INVITE.

lines.speaker: The Recurring Meeting
lines.text: DECLINING... REQUIRES A REASON. IN WRITING. IN BLOOD. IN TRIPLICATE.

lines.speaker: The Recurring Meeting
lines.text: MEETING... CANCELLED... TIME... RETURNED TO SENDER...
The dungeon exhales. Somewhere above, ten thousand calendars clear at once. The sound is like rain.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The free afternoon, hero. It's REAL. What do we do with it?!

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Absolutely nothing.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: A LEGEND. YOU'RE A LEGEND.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Org Chart followed us from the Crystal Caverns. It attends EVERY meeting now. It has no agenda. It IS an agenda.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: It waved at me during wave two.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Do not wave back. That's how you get a dotted line.
The temperature drops. A frost elemental materializes holding a beach ball with questions written on it.

lines.speaker: The Icebreaker
lines.text: BEFORE WE FIGHT: name, role, and a FUN FACT about yourself.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: The Icebreaker
lines.text: "No" is not a fun fact. I will now assign you one. YOUR FUN FACT IS FEAR.
The final conference room. On the ancient agenda, a single item, written before language: [YOU].

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Recurring Meeting has no end date, hero. If we lose, we're agenda items FOREVER.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Then let's table it. Permanently.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: That's the most beautiful thing you've ever said.
